'''Ukert''' was an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], the leader of clan [[Ubskai]] who ran a small criminal operation on the planet [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

==Biography==
Ukert had always a background of collecting "junk" which he sold to customers. In [[Tal'cara]], his clan bought a warehouse with some [[speeder truck/Legends|trucks]] and opened the legitimate [[Reclamation Services, Inc.]] recycling operation. With the company as a cover, Ukert supplied his buyers with the trucks. He also served as a go-between for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], running [[freighter/Legends|freighters]] to the [[Botha Ammunitions Corporation]], in which there were [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster ammo packs]] tagged as defective. Selling them to the Rebels, he shared the profit with Bothamco.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide" />

He was known as a rival of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] crime lord, [[Maxeena Sov'lya]]. 

One day, he met some Rebel members in the [[Kothlis Starport]], while they were repairing their [[freighter/Legends|freighter]]. He offered 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to pick up a load of recyclables from Bothamco. As the Rebels' ship was needing repairs and upgrades, they accepted the job. Once they returned (with smuggled power packs and [[blaster gas/Legends|gas]] canisters) he offered another thousand if they would deliver another load to [[Rithgar]] (to whom he owed a debt) in the [[Kothlis shadowport]]; when they mentioned [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Bothamco)|a suspicious bounty hunter]], he doubled the fee, and claimed that it was an old rival who worked against him.<ref name="Garbage Run">{{WEGCite|story=Garbage Run|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Ukert was a talented and cunning businessbeing. He used to wear fancy clothes which contrasted against his revolting and pudgy Ugnaught anatomy; his looks made many to mistake his astuteness.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide" />
